verdict.rationale: Medusa publishes complete OpenAPI 3.0 specs for its Store and Admin APIs, and these power its own API reference at docs.medusajs.com/api, so a first-party API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and the probe found no OpenAPI file at the common docs-site paths. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, hands-on or independent corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Medusa maintains complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specifications for the Store (and Admin) REST APIs in the medusajs/medusa repository; they power the docs.medusajs.com/api reference.
